nodes.doc:
**Erdős–Szekeres theorem.** If `n > r * s`, every injective sequence `f : Fin n → α` into a
linear order has a strictly increasing subsequence of length `r + 1` or a strictly decreasing
subsequence of length `s + 1`.
nodes.pretty:
{α : Type u_1} →
  [inst : @LinearOrder α] →
    {r s n : Nat} →
      (f : Fin n → α) →
        @Function.Injective (Fin n) α f →
          @LT.lt Nat instLTNat (@HMul.hMul Nat Nat Nat (@instHMul Nat instMulNat) r s) n →
            Or
              (@Exists (@Finset (Fin n)) fun t =>
                And (@Eq Nat (@Finset.card (Fin n) t) (@HAdd.hAdd Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd Nat instAddNat) r 1))
                  (@StrictMonoOn (Fin n) α (@PartialOrder.toPreorder (Fin n) (Fin.instPartialOrder n))
                    (@PartialOrder.toPreorder α
                      (@SemilatticeInf.toPartialOrder α
                        (@Lattice.toSemilatticeInf α
                          (@DistribLattice.toLattice α (@instDistribLatticeOfLinearOrder α inst)))))
                    f (@SetLike.coe (@Finset (Fin n)) (Fin n) (@Finset.instSetLike (Fin n)) t)))
              (@Exists (@Finset (Fin n)) fun t =>
                And (@Eq Nat (@Finset.card (Fin n) t) (@HAdd.hAdd Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd Nat instAddNat) s 1))
                  (@StrictAntiOn (Fin n) α (@PartialOrder.toPreorder (Fin n) (Fin.instPartialOrder n))
                    (@PartialOrder.toPreorder α
                      (@SemilatticeInf.toPartialOrder α
                        (@Lattice.toSemilatticeInf α
                          (@DistribLattice.toLattice α (@instDistribLatticeOfLinearOrder α inst)))))
                    f (@SetLike.coe (@Finset (Fin n)) (Fin n) (@Finset.instSetLike (Fin n)) t)))
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {n : Nat} (f : Fin n → α) (i : Fin n), LE.le 1 (ErdosSzekeres.incLen f i)

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {n : Nat} {f : Fin n → α} {i j : Fin n},
  Function.Injective f →
    LT.lt i j →
      Ne (Prod.mk (ErdosSzekeres.incLen f i) (ErdosSzekeres.incLen (Function.comp (⇑OrderDual.toDual) f) i))
        (Prod.mk (ErdosSzekeres.incLen f j) (ErdosSzekeres.incLen (Function.comp (⇑OrderDual.toDual) f) j))

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {n : Nat} {f : Fin n → α} {i j : Fin n},
  LT.lt i j → LT.lt (f i) (f j) → LT.lt (ErdosSzekeres.incLen f i) (ErdosSzekeres.incLen f j)

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {n : Nat} {f : Fin n → α} {i : Fin n} {k : Nat},
  LE.le k (ErdosSzekeres.incLen f i) → Exists fun t => And (Eq t.card k) (StrictMonoOn f ↑t)

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {n : Nat} (f : Fin n → α) (i : Fin n),
  Exists fun t => And (Membership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.incSeqs f i) t) (Eq t.card (ErdosSzekeres.incLen f i))

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {n : Nat} (f : Fin n → α) (i : Fin n),
  Membership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.incSeqs f i) (Singleton.singleton i)

∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {n : Nat} {f : Fin n → α} {i : Fin n} {t : Finset (Fin n)},
  Iff (Membership.mem (ErdosSzekeres.incSeqs f i) t) (And (IsGreatest (↑t) i) (StrictMonoOn f ↑t))
